## Use
### A.Phone, SK Telecom (AI Product Manager, 2021-2024)
- Found in user data that a 70% Android base locked out iPhone users in their 20s
- Built the industry's first iPhone call recording (mVoIP, within Apple's guidelines)
- 0 to 1 in 4 months; 1M MAU in 6 months; 10M+ MAU by Feb 2026
- 7M iOS users vs. 2M on the legacy app; call app pool grew from 10M to 14.5M
- Top 3 company-wide achievement, 2024

## Trust
### Incheon Fire Department
- Fixed spam filtering that hid firefighters' callbacks; added caller ID for first responders
- Emergency call success 74.7% to 85.8%; missed-call callbacks 27.9% to 49.5%
### AI safety at launch
- Hallucination evaluation criteria set as launch gates, agreed by engineering and legal
- Privacy masking false positives cut 36%

## Translate
### SKT AI Platform (GTM & Global Partnerships, 2024-2025)
- LLM Gateway grown to 4M+ daily requests in year one
- Integrated OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, and Adobe
- Exclusive OpenAI B2C partnership at 75% below the initial ask
- Together AI investment; LLM serving costs cut 30%
### Telco LLM (Global Telco AI Alliance)
- Coordinated SKT's use case with AWS and Anthropic: foundation model fine-tuned on contact center calls, RAG on AWS, AI contact center PoC
- Faded before other carriers adopted it, as foundation model progress outpaced fine-tuning cycles
### Keynote narrative
- AI-first story for C-level keynotes at CES 2025, MWC, DTW Ignite, and AWS Summit Seoul (26,000+ executives)

## Building now
- OWOL Archive, Founder (2025-2026): AI booking and translation agent; 20+ owner interviews; pivoted into existing messengers; halted after weighing costs against willingness to pay; began from my own photo studio work with foreign clients; v1 Portrai paired beauty-tuned interpretation AI with human interpreters and a booking platform (₩350K avg ticket, 17% take rate), but willingness to pay was too low; v2 messenger agent API was outrun by free tools like LLMs and Papago. Story: https://junelim12.github.io/owol.html
- Kaybridge (venture, 2026): AI platform routing Bay Area startups to decision owners inside Korean enterprises; one deal done by hand, cold to preferred bidder in ~4 months. Case study: https://junelim12.github.io/kaybridge.html
- Master Yun (hackathon, AWS Loft, 2026): voice-guided Korean saju reader that blends the Four Pillars with Western astrology; reading engine built on GitHub, app in Lovable, voice via the ElevenLabs API. Live: https://karma-key-generator.lovable.app · Story: https://junelim12.github.io/saju.html
- BaeAI (product concept, 2026): Hinge-style dating app for North American women where every match is an AI Korean man; hidden match tiers, unlockable dates, photos and calls, relationship state machine with endings. 48-screen wireframe. Story: https://junelim12.github.io/baeai.html
- Side projects: Voice AI content automation
